title: Bulk Regulations in M1-6D Districts
previewText: In M1-6D Districts, the bulk regulations of a C6-4A District shall apply except that the maximum height of a building or other structure within 100 feet of a wide street shall be 290 feet

amendmentHistory.projectName: City of Yes for Housing Opportunity
amendmentHistory.notes: Added text, simplifying M1-6D bulk regulations, and consolidating provisions of Sections 43-621 through 43-626 into this Section
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying multiple Sections to expand opportunities for housing within all zoning districts, and across all 59 of the City’s Community Districts
